name: destiny-agent-grimoire

tables.books: lore book metadata (slug matches live categories/book-<slug>)
tables.book_entries: entries within books (provenance via parent book)
tables.transcripts: transcript headers (curated markdown, Ishtar web, cutscene captions)
tables.transcript_lines: canonical dialogue lines by speaker (seq ordered, stage directions flagged)
tables.items: weapons/armor/gear lore and flavor text (text may be empty for stat-only items)
tables.character_lines: verified character quotes with resolvable source_slug
tables.fts: FTS5 index over all content, with a source column for exact type filtering
tables.verify_fts: normalized text + provenance for fast quote verification (FTS5 porter)
tables.document_classification: season/event per book and record with confidence
tables.coverage_notes: explicit status and evidence for zero-coverage activities, events and seasons
tables.manifest_links: curated activity/season to manifest hash mapping
tables.seals: manifest seal nodes with triumph counts
tables.seal_records: triumph records belonging to each seal
tables.item_sets: curated manifest armor sets mapped to season/event/expansion
tables.item_set_members: set membership and resolved item ids

views.v_speakers: speaker, lines (canonical speakers with line counts)
views.v_event_coverage: transcripts, lines and occurrences per event

search.usage: query.py search "<term>" [--type T] [--activity A] [--season S] [--event E] [--expansion X] [--class hunter|titan|warlock] [--limit N] [--offset N] [--rank|--no-rank] [--json] [--full]
search.returns: snippet context by default; --full for complete text

character.returns: curated quotes by default; --all for raw transcript lines

verify.returns: source/slug/speaker matches with exact flags; exit 1 when absent

book.usage: query.py book "<slug or title>" [--limit N] [--offset N] [--full] [--json]

transcript.usage: query.py transcript "<slug or title>" [--speaker NAME] [--section NAME] [--canon-only] [--class hunter|titan|warlock] [--limit N] [--offset N] [--full] [--json]

activity.usage: query.py activity "<slug or name>" [--limit N] [--offset N] [--json]
activity.returns: activity metadata, coverage, speakers and transcripts

event.returns: event metadata, yearly occurrences and transcripts

coverage.returns: coverage per activity, season and event plus gap lists

lore.returns: lore entry body, subtitle and linked item titles

contracts.quote_policy: quote must trace to speaker-attributed canon; verify before quoting
contracts.counts: authoritative counts come from the database; docs are synced by tests/sync-doc-counts.py

api: db/api.py (importable query layer used by the CLI and MCP server)

mcp.notes: limits clamp to 1-100; full text trimmed to 4000 chars; no arbitrary SQL
